lines: It lifts your face along the natural line of your brow bone.
The graduated arch creates elegance without effort.
Oval faces carry this shape beautifully — it works with your proportions, not against them.
It lifts your face along a clean, defined line.
A pointed peak creates definition without heaviness.
Round faces meet this shape well — its angle adds definition to soft curves.
It follows the soft curve of your brow bone.
A rounded crest creates softness without losing shape.
Square faces are softened by this shape — its curve answers the angle of your jaw.
It frames your eyes with a level, composed line.
A flat, even top creates presence without drama.
Heart faces find balance here — it steadies a broad forehead without adding height.
It follows the soft curve of your brow bone.
A rounded crest creates softness without losing shape.
Diamond faces are softened by this shape — it gives your cheekbones a gentler frame.
It frames your eyes with one level, uninterrupted line.
A straight brow creates calm without effort.
Oblong faces are balanced by this shape — its level line adds width, where a peak would add length.
It lifts your face along the natural line of your brow bone.
The graduated arch creates elegance without effort.
Triangle faces carry this shape well — it brings height and attention to the upper face.

headline: Your face is balanced,
a little longer than wide,
its jaw gently rounded.
body: An arch placed fractionally above the
brow bone's peak draws the eye upward —
creating lift without effort.

headline: Your face is soft and full,
close to equal in width
and length.
body: A sharp peak, set slightly further along
the brow, adds a clean angle against your
soft curves — lifting and lengthening.

headline: Your forehead and jaw are
close in width, the jaw
clearly defined.
body: A rounded brow, its crest set nearer the
inner end, brings a gentle curve to clear
angles — softening without disguising.

headline: Your forehead is your widest
point, your face narrowing
towards the chin.
body: A structured brow, low and level, set
nearer the inner end, steadies the width
above and draws the eye to your centre.

headline: Your cheekbones are widest,
with a narrower forehead
and a narrower jaw.
body: A rounded brow, its crest set near the
middle, softens the angle at the cheekbone
and keeps your proportions in balance.

headline: Your face is long and even,
forehead, cheeks and jaw
close in width.
body: A straight brow draws the eye across
rather than up, giving a long face
width and a calm, level line.

headline: Your jaw is your widest
point, with a narrower
forehead above it.
body: An arch, its peak set a touch further
along the brow, lifts the eye to the upper
face and balances the width of your jaw.

screen_30_structured.headline: Notice how structure frames your eyes.

line.refine: Your own shape, filled and groomed toward a structured line.
line.reshape: A structured line gives the upper face clear shape and quiet precision.
